title: Mono numeric date
description: Recasts the date as a compact numeric "23/08" set in the same mono + tabular-nums treatment as the clock time, so the date's digits align to the same grid as the time's digits and read as one unified numeral system rather than a separate sans caption.

changes.intent: Produce a numeric DD/MM date string instead of the weekday+month words.
changes.detail: Replace the { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' } formatter with a numeric one: toLocaleDateString('es-CR', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' }) → '23/08'. Weekday word is dropped entirely in this variant.

changes.intent: Match the date's numerals to the clock time's mono/tabular treatment so the two lines feel like one typographic family.
